# Bergamot translator glue

`bergamot-translator.js` is the Emscripten JavaScript glue of the Bergamot translation engine (Marian compiled to WebAssembly). It defines one global function, `loadBergamot(Module)`, and is loaded with `importScripts()` in a classic Worker (`bergamot-worker.js`).

The file is kept byte for byte as published. Do not edit it; replace it together with the WebAssembly binary pinned in `scripts/fetch-bergamot.mjs`, because the glue and the binary must come from the same build.

The matching WebAssembly binary is not stored in the repository. `scripts/fetch-bergamot.mjs` downloads it from Mozilla Remote Settings (collection `main/translations-wasm-v2`, `bergamot-translator` 4.0, release v0.6.0, revision `1de4a085d3a7afb625c51a60aabb5ad298e4059f`, also MPL-2.0) at build time and checks its sha256.
